findings.evidence: Frozen manifest and complete history transport retain path/bytes/sha256. Consumers separately authenticate bytes and pass only path/sha256 to the unchanged io.read. Real manifest inventories and all actual temporary history chunks pass the regression. Ordinary native/report/owner references remain original two-field refs.

The adapter imports the accepted History/Authority, original RetainedLock, Service, check_running and package check_ack/save_history/join_history/owned_terminal. History resolves full original/current catalog, witness and source partitions. The supervisor reassembles all transported chunks before releasing the first leaf. Admission is pinned to the root spec/review and current history. No new approval/lifecycle framework is introduced.

Fixed ordered eight layouts use separate Popen argv with distinct binding/work/cache paths. Parent observes full actual child identity before publishing layout-release. It records actual Popen.wait return code and requires only the supervisor in the recursive cgroup after every successful child and before every next child. Any child, validation, budget, identity or descendant failure exits the loop without a retry or automatic successor. Outer original Service cleanup owns whole-cgroup final drain.
findings.topic: Fresh serial execution and descendant isolation

findings.evidence: Immutable limits remain 900 seconds per layout from before directory/child setup through validation, 7200 seconds for the service and supervisor including ACK/startup, 9000 seconds outer history preparation/coordination. Per-layout active clock is independently checked by outer resource polling; supervisor capture polls during blocking leaf trace. The service has RuntimeMaxSec 7200. Cleanup may retain the serial lease beyond work deadlines until physical drain, without extending workload.

Both allocated and logical bytes count. Every layout including cache/tmp/artifacts/report/logs is limited to 1 GiB; common metadata and all layouts total 8 GiB. Each model.pt is 128 MiB, complete report 16 MiB, log 8 MiB. Atomic report updates retain old complete versions and count both while present. Initial NVMe floor is 30+8+2=40 GiB, subsequently 30 GiB + remaining allocated output allowance + 2 GiB. Root floor remains 28 GiB, independent NVMe floor 30 GiB, separate LFM 54 GiB unchanged. Mounted/distinct-volume checks and symlink/special-file rejection remain.

NC0, CPUs 6/7, nice19, one torch/BLAS thread, 6 GiB MemoryMax, 5 GiB MemoryHigh and zero swap are exact. Original service-property validation is supplemented by actual cgroup limits/OOM checks and descendant CPU subset checks. Fresh per-layout cache/tmp directories and absent bytecode prefixes are explicit in clean environment and argv.

Original leaf/protocol remain frozen: 32 graphs, at most two live graphs per mode, all 625 mappings, raw/finite profiles, BF16/FP32, MUST_ALIAS actual state/old reads and exact bytes. Validator matches all 5796 calls/layout and all 46368 total calls, full byte counts and hashes, controls and actual paired timing samples; artifacts retain complete stable file hashes. Primitive synchronous host-call timing is not device-only or model speedup.

Native imports wait for original current actual-tool root running ACK plus exact parent layout-release. Original cleanup and accepted owned_terminal preserve no-install double absence, late installation identity and real failed exit status. Independent rerun covers no-install, installed exit7, partial installation/delayed drain, and incomplete result despite zero service exit. Serial lease releases only after original physical drain proof. Final reconciliation requires the matching actual external session and separately observed owner/service disappearance.
